design.step: SECURITY between VERIFY and REVIEW; run status VERIFYING; mission VERIFYING -> REVIEWING now happens when SECURITY completes (previously at VERIFY completion); checkpoint is written after SECURITY
design.freshClones: built-in diff + commit-message scan and trivy run in <run>/security-c<cycle> (existing freshClone helper); gitleaks runs against a fresh bare clone <run>/security-gl-c<cycle>.git
design.gitleaks: gitleaks git --redact --config <engine toml> --gitleaks-ignore-path <empty engine file> --ignore-gitleaks-allow --log-opts '--text --no-textconv --no-ext-diff --diff-merges=first-parent <base>..<head>' (c2: --diff-merges=first-parent added, see remediation); raw report deleted after parsing, sha256 kept
design.trivy: trivy fs --scanners vuln --skip-db-update --skip-java-db-update --offline-scan --skip-check-update --skip-vex-repo-update --skip-version-check --disable-telemetry --config '' --ignorefile '' --cache-dir <explicit>; DB missing/unreadable -> trivy not started, PARTIAL TRIVY_DB_UNAVAILABLE; DB older than 7 days -> scan runs, PARTIAL
design.sast: semgrep only discovered; recorded NOT_AVAILABLE (TOOL_NOT_INSTALLED, or TOOL_INSTALLED_NOT_INTEGRATED if installed); SBOM recorded NOT_AVAILABLE (NOT_IMPLEMENTED)
design.policy: secret (gitleaks or built-in) -> BLOCKED SECRET_DETECTED; trivy HIGH/CRITICAL -> BLOCKED VULNERABLE_DEPENDENCY; scanner error/unparsable/oversized report/changed binary -> BLOCKED SECURITY_TOOL_ERROR; MEDIUM/LOW recorded only; timeout/spawn failure -> bounded RETRY
design.evidence: SECURITY_GITLEAKS, SECURITY_TRIVY, SECURITY_REPORT (logPath + sha256, evidence.security = redacted SecurityStageSummary); report.json gets a security section with founderNotice; PARTIAL ends AWAITING_APPROVAL with reason 'DELIVERY_DECISION_PENDING_FOUNDER; SECURITY_COVERAGE_PARTIAL'

finding.summary: gitleaks --log-opts had no merge-diff option; git log -p emits no patch for merge commits, so content introduced only by a merge commit (evil merge / conflict resolution) was never scanned and the SECURITY stage reported CLEAN.

remediation.fix: core/workos/security-tools.ts runGitleaks: --log-opts is now '--text --no-textconv --no-ext-diff --diff-merges=first-parent <base>..<head>'. README security section updated.
tests: tests/v7-b3c-security-stage.test.ts 'merge commits in base..head are scanned (B3C-C1-F1)': stub test, implementer builds main2 + side commits and a --no-ff --no-commit merge with an extra file; asserts rev-list --merges base..head contains the head and the gitleaks --log-opts includes --diff-merges=first-parent; the existing CLEAN stub argv assertion was updated.

tests/v7-b3c-security-stage.test.ts real-gitleaks 'an evil merge (secret only in the merge commit) ...': same history shape with a runtime-built stripe-style fake key (a type the built-in scan does not recognise) only in the merge commit; real gitleaks 8.30.1 reports FINDINGS (evil.cfg, stripe-access-token, commit == head sha), run BLOCKED SECRET_DETECTED, builtin hits 0, no secret value in any persisted file.
